raisedIn: Brighton Beach, Brooklyn, New York City
background: Born and raised in Brighton Beach, Brooklyn, by Russian-Jewish immigrant parents, around a samovar that never went cold.
regionalHistory: Her grandparents' stories hold Leningrad winters, quiet faith kept behind closed doors, and tea with too much sugar.
